title: Marvel unveils first 'VisionQuest' trailer
excerpt: Strap in for the most bizarre AI existential crisis on TV.

Strap in for the most bizarre AI existential crisis on TV.

on August 15, 2026

Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on Flipboard

Marvel Studios debuted the first trailer for its Disney+ series VisionQuest at D23 in Anaheim, California, offering the clearest look yet at Paul Bettany's return as the sentient AI hero Vision.

The trailer finds Vision living in hiding and grappling with an existential crisis after essentially being resurrected in WandaVision. As part of his search for answers, Vision converses with several other artificial intelligences drawn from his own programming, including FRIDAY (Orla Bradley), DUM-E (Henry Lewis), JARVIS (James D'Arcy), and Ultron (James Spader). Much of Ultron is shown in human form in the footage, and the other Tony Stark-created AIs appear less than thrilled to have him around. An understandable reaction, given that Ultron nearly wiped out humanity in Avengers: Age of Ultron.

According to Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige, VisionQuest will serve as the final installment in what he's calling the "Wanda trilogy," following WandaVision and Agatha All Along. It's also expected to be Marvel's last live-action Disney+ series for the foreseeable future, part of a broader pullback from television that multiple outlets have reported in recent months. That shift already led to the cancellation of Wonder Man, which drew backlash from fans after the show was scrapped just months after being renewed for a second season.

VisionQuest premieres on Disney+ on Oct. 14.

漫威影业在加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆的 D23 上发布了其 Disney+ 系列 VisionQuest 的首部预告片，以最清晰的方式展示了保罗·贝坦尼作为有感知力的人工智能英雄 Vision 的回归。

预告片中，幻视在《旺达幻视》中复活后，一直生活在躲藏之中，并努力应对生存危机。 作为寻找答案的一部分，视觉与其他几个从他自己的程序中提取的人工智能进行了对话，包括星期五（奥拉·布拉德利饰）、DUM-E（亨利·刘易斯饰）、贾维斯（詹姆斯·达西饰）和奥创（詹姆斯·斯派德饰）。 奥创的大部分内容在镜头中都以人类的形式出现，而托尼·斯塔克创造的其他人工智能似乎对他在身边并不感到兴奋。 这是可以理解的反应，因为奥创在《复仇者联盟：奥创纪元》中几乎消灭了人类。

漫威影业总裁凯文·费奇表示，《VisionQuest》将成为他所谓的“旺达三部曲”的最后一部，继《旺达幻视》和《阿加莎一直以来》之后。 预计这也将是漫威在可预见的未来最后一部真人版迪士尼+系列剧，这是近几个月多家媒体报道的更广泛电视撤军的一部分。 这一转变已经导致《神奇侠》被取消，该剧在续订第二季几个月后就被取消，引起了粉丝的强烈反对。

VisionQuest 将于 10 月 14 日在 Disney+ 首播。

Chance Townsend 是 Mashable 的总任务编辑，涵盖技术、视频游戏、约会应用程序、数字文化以及他遇到的任何其他内容。 他拥有北德克萨斯大学新闻学硕士学位，是一位自豪的橙猫父亲。 他的作品还出现在《PC Mag》和《Mother Jones》上。
